The 28th Annual #Chemistry and #Biochemistry Graduate Research Conference ( #CBGRC ) will be held at #Concordia University in #Montreal, QC. Organised by a dedicated group of graduate students in Chemistry and Biochemistry it is a popular event for #graduate students to present their #research.

Join them at the beautiful Loyola campus in Montreal!

This year’s theme is "Catalysis." Keynote speakers include Prof. Sophie Rousseaux/UofT and Prof. Daniela Quaglia/UQAM. 

Key dates — 
#Conference: 20 Nov 2026, early bird registration: 21 Aug - 6 Oct, abstract submission until 6 Nov.
